steps.question: Which genes differ between the treated (batch B2) and control (batch B1) samples under the only estimable model, ~condition, and how large are those differences?

constraints: Permutations must break the true condition/batch grouping; the true split and its exact complement must be excluded from the null

steps.description: Stress-test the T1S2 ranking three ways. (1) Permutation null: repeatedly relabel the 12 samples into random 6-vs-6 splits that break the true grouping (use all or a large random subset of the 462 possible splits, excluding the true split and its complement), rerun the DE test on each — a fast test such as edgeR quasi-likelihood or limma-voom is acceptable here for tractability, stated explicitly — and report the distribution of the number of genes at padj < 0.05. Place the observed count on that distribution. (2) Leave-one-out stability: drop one sample from each group in turn, rerun the ~condition contrast, and report how often each of the top 100 genes remains significant, plus the rank correlation of test statistics across resamples. constraints: Use the ranked statistic from T1S2 for GSEA; do not re-derive fold changes
ORA universe must be the filtered, tested gene set from T1S2 — not all 12,000 input genes and not a genome-wide default

caveats: The user may want a treatment gene list regardless; provide it, correctly labelled, rather than withholding it

steps.question: Given that batch B1/B2 is perfectly confounded with control/treated, what can and cannot be concluded from these 12 lung RNA-seq samples, and what design or additional data would make the treatment effect estimable?
constraints: Do not soften the confounding conclusion into a footnote — it is the headline
Do not recommend any post-hoc batch-correction method as a fix for this design
Do not propose in-sandbox download of external validation data; the environment has no network access
steps.description: Assemble a single written synthesis from T1S1 (confound diagnosis, QC), T1S3 (permutation calibration, leave-one-out stability, technical-artefact diagnostics) and T2S1 (enrichment coherence). State the headline conclusion first: the treated-vs-control gene list is a treatment+batch composite and cannot be attributed to treatment from these data alone. A final annotated gene table is delivered, labelled as a treated(B2)-vs-control(B1) composite contrast, flagging the leave-one-out-robust subset
At least three concrete design remedies are given, each with what it would resolve
Analyses that remain valid under the confound are separated from those that do not
No statement anywhere attributes an expression change to treatment

plan.title: Treated vs control lung DE under confounded batch
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a 12,000 x 12 raw salmon count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbols in column 1) with metadata.csv giving condition (6 treated, 6 control) and batch. The decisive fact from the profile is that batch B1 contains all 6 controls and B2 all 6 treated samples: the batch effect and the treatment effect are perfectly aliased. No statistical method can separate them — a model with ~condition + batch is rank-deficient, and any 'batch correction' (ComBat, removeBatchEffect, SVA) applied to this design either fails or silently removes the biological effect along with the technical one. The plan therefore does the one honest thing: it runs the treated-vs-control contrast that the question asks for, labels every result as a condition+batch composite effect rather than a treatment effect, and spends the rest of its effort quantifying how much of the observed separation could be technical.

T1S1 establishes the design's identifiability formally (cross-tabulation, design-matrix rank check, PCA/hierarchical clustering coloured by both factors, library-size and detection-rate comparison across batches) so the confounding is documented from the data itself rather than asserted from metadata. T1S2 runs DESeq2 on ~condition alone — the only estimable model — producing the ranked gene table the question asks for, with shrunken LFCs and explicit naming of the estimand as 'treated/B2 vs control/B1'. T1S3 stress-tests that ranking: technical-artefact diagnostics (do hits track GC/length-independent proxies such as expression level and detection rate, are hits dominated by low-count genes), a permutation null to calibrate how many hits a random 6-vs-6 split of these samples yields, and a leave-one-out-per-group stability check. A DE list that survives none of these is noise; a list that survives them is still not attributable to treatment, and the step must say so.

T2S1 runs hallmark and GO-BP enrichment on the ranked statistic against the staged human MSigDB GMTs, as a coherence read: a signature dominated by ribosomal/mitochondrial/stress-and-handling terms argues technical; a coherent treatment-relevant lung biology signature is weak circumstantial evidence the effect is not purely batch, and must be framed as circumstantial only. T2S2 writes the interpretation and the design remedy — which comparisons remain valid, what an unconfounded re-design or a batch-balanced replication would need, and what external evidence (e.g. an independent cohort with the same perturbation) would be required to attribute anything here to treatment. No step claims a treatment effect, because this design cannot support one.
